title: A Tryouts for the Prom
author: Petra Blackwood
blurb: Noor Almeida, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
